rows.grounds: optative third singular of as (to be)
instrumental plural of ghṛtākta (ghee-anointed) plus disjunctive vā (or)
adjective madhu-pluta (honey-soaked), agreeing with the ritual substance

items.question: What anointing or soaking condition yields food prosperity after a year?
premises: Food prosperity arises after a year.
Ghee-anointed or honey-soaked substances are specified.
The verse states a conditional ritual result.
items.inference: The verse links yearly food prosperity to ghee-anointed or honey-soaked ritual substances.
uncertainties: The exact grammatical relation of madhuplutaḥ to ghṛtāktairvvā remains unclear.
The implied ritual object or offering is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: After a year, food prosperity becomes, with ghee-anointed or honey-soaked substances.
